description: This PHP source file defines the class EmailSubscriptionMenuConfigurator, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface to configure menu items related to email subscriptions within the OrangeHRM admin module. It overrides a screen related to email notification configuration.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration for email subscriptions by overriding the email notification screen in the admin module.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen named 'viewEmailNotification' using the current module and screen context; returns null.
